summary: Tested Response Defaults migration from Discord Settings (scripted mode section) to Bot Settings global card. All backend endpoints and frontend flows work correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is >3200 lines; recommend modularization into routers (admin, discord, instances) for maintainability.

GET /api/admin/instances/{id}/reply-defaults does NOT return 404 for unknown instance IDs — it silently returns default fallback content. Not a bug per current design (used as fallback loader) but consider explicit 404 for consistency with PUT which does 404.
PUT reply-defaults accepts any strings without length limits; consider max length validation on fallback_message and ack items to avoid unbounded storage.
seed_data_creation: Restored Scripted Test instance reply defaults to original ack list + fallback after tests.
